title: A canned job is added without its inactive parts and one warning names them
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create three active parts for this test, part A, part B and part C, with part A's number coming before part B's from A to Z.
  • Create a canned job for this test, canned job A, holding parts A, B and C, one of each.
  • Set parts A and B inactive after canned job A is saved.
  • Create an open work order, work order 1, for this test, with no lines.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Line.
  2. Type the start of canned job A's title in the Title field.
  3. Click the canned job A suggestion.
  4. Click Save & Close.
  5. Wait 10 seconds without closing the warning.
  6. Click Close on the warning.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Line window opens.

Step 2:

  • Canned job A is suggested, with Total Parts: 3.

Step 3:

  • The canned job A line is filled in.

Step 4:

  • Work order 1 gets a new line, canned job A, holding one part, part C; parts A and B are not on it.
  • One warning shows at the bottom right for the whole canned job: "These parts are inactive and were not added:" followed by part A's and part B's part numbers, in A to Z order, each as it shows on the Inactive tab, separated by a comma and a space.

Step 5:

  • The warning is still on screen after 10 seconds: it stays until closed.

Step 6:

  • The warning closes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R9: “Applying a canned job adds the job without its inactive parts.”
  • S9-R10: “When a canned job leaves out parts, the system shows one warning listing every part left out: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." The warning stays until the user closes it.”
  • S9-R10b: “The warning names each part by the inventory part's own number, as it shows on the Inactive tab, not by the number as typed in the canned job.”
  • S9-R10c: “When two or more parts are left out, they are listed A to Z by part number, separated by ", ". Example: "These parts are inactive and were not added: AB-100, FF-5507."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Canned job leaves out inactive parts | "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." plus "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." for each fee left out | Warning toast, one per canned job, stays until closed”
